privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Maw3ed stores about you, why, and who can see it. We keep it short because we keep very little.

who.title: Who we are
who.p1: Maw3ed is a booking and reminders service for salons, barbers, clinics and physiotherapists. Each business that uses Maw3ed runs its own appointments; Maw3ed provides the software.

collect.title: What we store
collect.p1: When you book, we store only what is needed to run the appointment:
collect.b2: your phone number, in international format
collect.b4: the appointment time, the service and the staff member
collect.p2: We do not ask for notes or free-text details about you, and we do not store payment card data. Deposits, where a business offers them, are in test mode and no card is charged.

business.title: Business owners and staff
business.p1: A business account stores a name, an email address or, for staff the owner sets up, a phone number, and a password, which is kept only as a one-way hash. A session cookie keeps you signed in on your device.

use.title: How we use it
use.p1: We use your details only to run your booking:
use.b1: to show and confirm the appointment to the business
use.b2: to send the booking email and the reminders
use.b3: to email you if a spot opens when you joined a waitlist
use.b4: to let the business see its own client history, including missed appointments

reminders.title: Reminders and messages
reminders.p1: We email a booking confirmation and reminders, about 24 hours and 2 hours before the appointment, with Confirm and Cancel links.
reminders.p2: A business can also send you a WhatsApp message itself (for example a reminder or an activation message for staff), with a button that opens WhatsApp on the business's own phone. The message is sent by the business from its own phone, not by Maw3ed. Maw3ed does not send WhatsApp messages.

sharing.title: Who sees your data
sharing.p1: The business you book with sees your booking details. We use these providers to run the service:
sharing.b4: Sentry (EU region), for error monitoring: errors only, with personal data removed where possible
sharing.p2: We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: Clients need no account. We use a language cookie to remember your choice and, for business users, a session cookie to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising cookies.

keep.title: How long we keep it, and deletion
keep.p1: We keep booking records while the business uses Maw3ed, so it can run its appointments and see its history. The business owner can delete a client: the record is then anonymised and no personal data of that client is left.
keep.p2: To have your data deleted, ask the business you booked with, or contact us.

security.title: Security
security.p1: Connections use HTTPS, each business can only reach its own data, links in emails are signed, and passwords are stored as one-way hashes. No system is perfectly secure, but we limit what we hold so there is little to lose.
security.p2: We use IP addresses briefly to limit abuse, for example to rate-limit booking, sign-in and directory requests.

children.title: Children
children.p1: Maw3ed is not aimed at children. A parent or guardian should book on behalf of a child.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.p1: Our providers may process data in other countries, including outside Lebanon. We choose providers that protect data, and we limit what we send them to what the service needs.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.p1: You can ask to see, correct or delete the details held about you. Start with the business you booked with, or contact us.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it last changed.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Maw3ed to book an appointment or to run a business on it.

about.title: What Maw3ed is
about.p1: Maw3ed is a booking and reminders platform. The business provides the service you book. Maw3ed is not a party to that service and does not provide it.

clients.title: If you book
clients.p1: Give correct details so the business can reach you. Use the Confirm and Cancel links if your plans change. Keep your confirmation links private.

businesses.title: If you run a business
businesses.p1: You are responsible for your listing, services, prices, opening hours and staff, and for the people you invite. You must have the right to contact your clients and you must treat their details as private.
businesses.p2: You decide how you handle your appointments, including what you offer and what you charge.

cancellations.title: Cancellations and no-shows
cancellations.p1: Cancellation and no-show rules are set by each business, not by Maw3ed. Maw3ed only records what the business tells it.

availability.title: Availability
availability.p1: Free times shown on Maw3ed can be taken by someone else before you book. The booking page shows what is free at that moment. We do not guarantee that a time, a business or the service itself will always be available.

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
acceptable.b1: break the law or harm others
acceptable.b2: make bookings you do not mean to keep, or book for someone else without their permission
acceptable.b3: try to reach data that is not yours, or to disrupt the service
acceptable.b4: send spam or misuse reminders and links

plans.title: Plans and payments
plans.p1: Maw3ed has a Free plan and a Pro plan. Checkout is currently in test mode: it is simulated and no card is charged.

liability.title: Limits of liability
liability.p1: Maw3ed is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for missed or late appointments, for what a business does or does not deliver, or for indirect losses.

termination.title: Ending use
termination.p1: You can stop using Maw3ed at any time. We may suspend an account that breaks these terms or puts the service at risk.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of Lebanon.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: We may update these terms. The date at the top shows when they last changed. If you keep using Maw3ed after a change, you accept the new terms.
